operations.title: Exact valuation functorially inherits the canonical tangential connection from the unbounded source calculus
operations.description: Because both wall tangents annihilate Lambda, the source connection commutes with Lambda and preserves ker Lambda, im Lambda, and im Lambda squared, hence descends to E2 without a splitting.
